sql.query: SELECT 'unassigned:' assignmentKey,'Unallocated' assignmentLabel,0 sortGroup UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('team:',t.id),t.teamName,1 FROM tbl_teams t WHERE t.tenantId=:tenantId AND t.isActive=1 AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') WHERE utr.userId=:adminUserId AND utr.tenantId=t.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_team_members tm ON tm.userTenantId=ut.id AND tm.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND tm.teamId=t.id AND tm.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_member_roles tmr ON tmr.teamMemberId=tm.id AND tmr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_role_permissions trp ON trp.teamRoleId=tmr.teamRoleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=trp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='team.tasks.assign' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE ut.userId=:teamUserId AND ut.tenantId=t.tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active')) ORDER BY sortGroup,assignmentLabel
